noelle: Quick dump from an adaptive-sampling speculative decode probe on q13b this morning. Posting raw so we can iterate.
noelle: Experiment sketch: dynamic per-request candidate count (1..6) based on prefix uncertainty; quant model q13b-q4_fast for fast-path, rescoring via cheap fp16 scorer, full fp16 fallback when composite trigger fires.
diego: how do you measure "prefix uncertainty" at request start?
noelle: used a tiny prefix model (8-layer distilled) to estimate prefix entropy and a fast delta-entropy over first 8 tokens; if prefix_entropy > 2.4 we start with pool=6 else pool=2. Also reduce pool once top candidates converge (JS<0.05 over 3 tokens).
tara: top-line latency & quality?
noelle: median end-to-end latency 2.7x lower than fp16 baseline for interactive prompts; with rescoring ~2.2x. p95 improved ~1.5x. Auto metrics: MMLU delta -0.6% (paired), SQuAD EM -0.9%. Human spot-check (80 pairs) flagged 5 chain-of-thought truncations and 3 rare-entity hallucinations; rescoring fixed 2 of the 3.
diego: interesting. Did you capture candidate divergence traces? any signal besides entropy that predicted hallucinations?
noelle: yes saved per-token JS and mean_pairwise_kl. Hallucination cases correlated better with high mean_pairwise_kl than entropy. So composite trigger = (entropy>t1) OR (mean_pairwise_kl>t2) was more effective.
bench-bot: run created jd-7129, artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/spec/3123456789/
noelle: Command used:
```
redwood-evals run --suite adaptive-spec:v1 \
  --model q13b-q4_adaptive --rescoring-model fp16-13b-scorer \
  --prefix-estimator distill8 --pool-min 1 --pool-max 6 \
  --js-prune 0.05 --entropy-start 2.4 --samples 3000 --tag adaptive-probe-01
```
diego: Nice. For evaluation stats please do paired A/B with per-sample diffs and a sign-test. Need N large for MMLU significance (10k). Also capture token logits for 0.5% of requests.
tara: Ops: propose 3% dedicated canary for 24h with metrics to track: fallback_rate, rescoring_ratio, latency_p50/p95, MMLU_delta, rare_entity_halluc_rate. Block if MMLU drops >1% with p<0.01 or halluc_rate up >0.4%.
ops-bot: Ticket created RED-2407: "adaptive-spec q13b canary + metrics" https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2407
noelle: Cost note: rough infra token cost down ~38% from fast-path; rescoring adds ~6% back. Net ~32% savings. Will add detailed cost per-token breakdown to artifacts.
diego: Suggest two follow-ups: 1) cheap rescoring-only pipeline (no full fallback) to test upper bound of quality recovery, 2) human eval focused on rare-entity QA + long-chain reasoning (1k pairs). I'll prototype the rescoring-only hook.
tara: I'll draft the human eval schema and sampling instructions. Also recommend logging pool_size_over_time and per-token_js to tune prune thresholds.
noelle: plan: run 10k multilingual holdout overnight, add pairwise KL trigger, upload artifacts, and open PR with eval config. Tagging @diego @tara for review. If anyone wants the quick artifacts they are at the CI link above.
diego: I'll take the pairwise-kl prototype and perf microbench to make sure runtime cost is small.
tara: I'll own the human eval. Keep notes terse so we can land runbook. :thumbsup:
